llms:
Formula Per scale (small and large, radii in cells) the TPI plane comes from the summed-area table; global standardization gives z = (TPI - mean)/standardDeviation over all valid cells of that scale (population statistics; z = 0 when the deviation is 0; local uses the window DEV instead). Class c(z): 0 if z <= -standardThreshold, 2 if z >= standardThreshold, else 1. With cs from the small scale and cl from the large one: cs 0 -> 1 + cl (canyon, midslope drainage, upland drainage); cs 1 -> cl 0: U-shaped valley 4, cl 1: plain 5 if Horn slope <= slopeThresholdDegrees else open slope 6, cl 2: upper slope 7; cs 2 -> 8 + cl (local ridge, midslope ridge, mountain top). Cells with an invalid elevation, position or slope get 0.
